title: polypodium nummulariifolium var. obovatum
intro: Polypodium nummulariifolium var. obovatum, commonly known as the Obovate Polypod, is a type of fern native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium nummulariifolium var. obovatum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
